Bajaj Finserv.summary: Bajaj Finance’s app offers UPI payments, a prepaid wallet and loan applications and repayments.

requirements.label: App registration
requirements.text: 18+ and able to enter a contract.

requirements.label: Bajaj Pay UPI
requirements.text: Link your bank account, register your device and set up a PIN/password.

requirements.label: Wallet UPI
requirements.text: Requires a valid Bajaj Pay Full KYC Wallet and its associated mobile number.

requirements.label: Personal loan
requirements.text: Indian citizen, 21–80, salaried or self-employed, with CIBIL 650+; age must be 80 or below when the loan ends. KYC and income documents are required; approval depends on assessment.

notes: Current app name: Bajaj Finance; Bajaj Markets is separate.
EMI card, deposit and other loan requirements not confirmed.

POP UPI.summary: POP offers UPI payments, shopping rewards, a YES BANK credit card and purchase instalments.
notes: UPI, card and POPchop joining requirements not confirmed. POPchop lender unknown; POPcard and POP-CLUB fees and rewards conflict.

Samsung Pay.summary: Samsung Pay is part of Samsung Wallet in India, with card and bank-account UPI payments.

requirements.label: Wallet setup
requirements.text: Requires a supported Samsung device, Samsung account and Wallet PIN or available biometrics.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Link a bank account with its registered mobile number and active SIM. Samsung’s new-PIN setup uses debit/ATM-card details.

requirements.label: Card payments
requirements.text: Requires a card supported by Samsung Pay and its issuer.

notes: Minimum age not confirmed.
Alternative UPI PIN setup options not confirmed.

Jupiter.summary: Jupiter offers UPI, savings tools and investments, with its All-in-1 Savings Account provided by Federal Bank.

requirements.label: All-in-1 Savings Account
requirements.text: Choose the account in Jupiter and complete video KYC. Identity and address details and Federal Bank checks are required.

requirements.label: Salary-account upgrade
requirements.text: Requires a full-KYC savings account, verified employer and work details and salary credited at the minimum shown in-app.

notes: Savings-account minimum age, nationality/residency rules and full document list not confirmed.
Joining requirements for standalone UPI, Jupiter Account PPI, investments, loans and cards not confirmed.

Flipkart UPI.summary: Flipkart launched in-app UPI transfers, merchant payments, recharges and bill payments with Axis Bank in 2024.
notes: UPI joining rules and current device support not confirmed; the 2024 launch was initially Android-only with @fkaxis.

BharatPe.summary: BharatPe offers consumer UPI, bill payments and credit, plus separate payment tools for merchants.

requirements.label: Consumer app
requirements.text: Must be able to enter a contract and be physically in India when registering, linking services and transacting.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Requires SIM binding and SMS verification.

notes: Minimum age not confirmed.
Consumer loan eligibility and merchant registration/KYC requirements not confirmed.

kiwi.summary: Kiwi offers bank-account and RuPay-card UPI payments, plus credit cards issued by partner banks.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Requires a Kiwi account, smartphone app, a supported bank/card account and that account’s registered mobile number.

requirements.label: Credit card application
requirements.text: 22–55, resident in India, and salaried or self-employed. A partner bank is assigned automatically; approval depends on credit history, income and employment.

requirements.label: Credit card documents
requirements.text: Original PAN is required for video KYC. The assigned bank may also request ITR, Form 16 or salary documents in-app.

notes: No common minimum income or credit-score cutoff confirmed for all partner cards.
Credit-line joining requirements not confirmed.

Omni Card.summary: OmniCard offers prepaid wallets, cards and UPI payments, plus tools for business expenses.

requirements.label: Prepaid wallet/card
requirements.text: Use a phone number that belongs to you. Small PPI wallets need mobile OTP verification and identity declarations; Full-KYC wallets need completed identity verification.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Pay from OmniCard without linking a personal bank account.

requirements.label: Business spending
requirements.text: Existing users must accept their enterprise’s invitation in the app.

notes: Minimum age and guardian-consent rules not confirmed.
Transfer and cash access depend on the wallet type.
Exact KYC document list and programme availability not confirmed.

Timepay.summary: TimePay offers UPI transfers, mobile recharges, bill payments and rewards.

requirements.label: App / UPI (2022 terms)
requirements.text: 18+ and able to enter a contract. Requires the Android app, an inserted registered SIM, internet, GPS, and an active Indian bank account with a debit card.

notes: Joining terms date to 2022; current debit-card, GPS and device requirements may differ.

SalarySe.summary: SalarySe offers salary access, loans, savings products and partner-bank credit cards.

requirements.label: App registration
requirements.text: 18+, with a guardian-consent exception. SIM/device binding is required; employment details may be collected.

requirements.label: RBL Bank UP card (Swiggy route)
requirements.text: 21–70, credit score 720+ and existing credit history; video KYC and RBL approval required. Repayments aren’t deducted from Swiggy earnings.

requirements.label: Partner-bank card applications
requirements.text: An existing active card from a participating bank may make you ineligible for another card through SalarySe.

notes: CUB Level UP, FD and personal-loan joining requirements not confirmed.
InstaCash employer-participation and income requirements not confirmed.

KreditPe.summary: Kredit.Pe offers UPI rewards, credit cards and fixed deposits.

requirements.label: App registration
requirements.text: Must be legally an adult and able to enter a contract. Register, link your account and give permission to check your credit score.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Use a bank account or RuPay credit card for payments.

requirements.label: SBM FD-backed card
requirements.text: Indian citizen over 18, with an SBM fixed deposit of ₹2,000 or more. No income proof or credit history needed; the card remains active while the FD does.

requirements.label: SBM FD-backed card: location
requirements.text: Unavailable to residents of Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, Manipur, Tripura, Meghalaya, Nagaland and Sikkim.

notes: Current availability of the SBM card not confirmed.
Max card and Unity FD joining requirements not confirmed.
UPI verification steps and product-specific credit-score cutoffs not confirmed.

OneCard.summary: OneCard is an app-managed credit card with rewards, spending controls and UPI for eligible cardholders.

requirements.label: Credit card application
requirements.text: 18+, Indian citizen, PAN, living in a supported city, with valid address/residence proof. Approval depends on credit reports and other checks.

requirements.label: OneCard UPI
requirements.text: Requires an existing One Credit Card, eligible app registration and your own bank account linked to an active mobile number.

notes: Check current city coverage in-app.
Income and credit-score cutoffs not confirmed; issuer and secured-card requirements may differ.

Scapia.summary: Scapia offers travel bookings and rewards with credit cards from different banks.

requirements.label: Federal Bank Scapia card
requirements.text: Resident Indian citizen; primary cardholders must be 21–65 if salaried or 25–65 if self-employed. Other Federal Bank card checks apply.

requirements.label: Scapia Axis Bank card
requirements.text: Indian resident, 18–70 for the primary cardholder. Requires PAN or Form 60, income proof such as payslips, Form 16 or ITR, and residence proof.

notes: Income and credit-score cutoffs not confirmed.
Available banks and other partner-card requirements need checking.

Rio Money.summary: Rio Money is now zagg.money, offering UPI payments, partner-bank credit cards and rewards.

requirements.label: Zagg account
requirements.text: Register and complete KYC; you must be over 18 or otherwise legally an adult and able to enter a contract. Credit-bureau information may be checked.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Use a savings account or RuPay credit card for payments.

notes: AU, PNB and YES BANK card eligibility, documents and supported locations not confirmed.
These are current Zagg rules; August 2026 Rio requirements not confirmed.

CheQ.summary: CheQ offers credit-card bill payments, rewards, bank-account UPI and an AU Bank credit card.

requirements.label: App / bill payments
requirements.text: 18+ and able to enter a contract; registration may involve identity and credit-score checks. Bill payments cover individually held cards or credit accounts; corporate cards are excluded.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Resident Indian, 18+, with an active participating-bank account and matching registered mobile number. Complete device-specific verification; SIM binding may be required.

requirements.label: CheQ AU card
requirements.text: 18+, Indian resident and able to enter a contract. Registration, AU’s KYC and creditworthiness checks are required; AU decides final eligibility and approval.

notes: AU card income and credit-score cutoffs not confirmed; additional bank criteria may apply.
